title: Ahom-Buranji: From the Earliest Time to the End of Ahom Rule (With Parallel English Translation)
author: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua
genre: Classical Tai-Ahom Chronicle with English Translation
description: Monumental bilingual master edition of the primary Ahom-Buranji, published under the authority of the Assam Administration by Baptist Mission Press, Calcutta. Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua presents the original Tai script on facing pages with an authoritative English translation, chronicling cosmogony, divine lineage from Lengdon, Sukapha's conquest, internal court politics, and Burmese invasions.
